title: Profile Visible Labels
prompt: A React profile list receives hidden items but should render only visible labels. Write a helper that returns labels for items where hidden is not true.

explanation.beginner:
Example: profileVisibleLabels([{"label":"A"},{"label":"B","hidden":true}]) produces ["A"]. Project each included record into the requested output shape, keeping the required input order.

Compare “handles all hidden items”: input [[{"label":"A","hidden":true}]] produces []. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
explanation.junior:
Project each included record into the requested output shape, keeping the required input order.

Tempting mistake: A projection is different from filtering: returning a boolean from map gives booleans, while returning a value from filter only makes a keep decision.

The reference uses filter, map. Trace the intermediate value after each operation; count repeated scans inside callbacks separately when estimating cost.

Regression check: preserve the contract illustrated by “handles all hidden items”, then change one boundary in a new test. The solution below is one implementation; another is valid when it preserves the same behavior.
